Hex.Page.Title: Hex
Hex.ReadFailure.AccessDeniedFormat: Windows won't let this app read "{0}". Its permissions may be limited to another account, or it may be protected by the system.
Hex.ReadFailure.MissingFormat: "{0}" isn't there any more. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted since the tab opened.
Hex.ReadFailure.LockedFormat: "{0}" is open in another program that isn't sharing it. Close whatever is using it and try again.
Hex.ReadFailure.TruncatedFormat: "{0}" stopped returning data part-way through. The drive or share it lives on may have gone away, or the file may have been replaced while the tab was open.
Hex.Toolbar.GoToTip: Enter hex offset (e.g. 1A2B) and press Enter
